Privacy Policy

Last Updated: October 2024

JT Protection Services LLC ("JT Protection Services," "we," "us," or "our") respects your privacy. This Privacy Policy explains what information we collect through our website, how we use it, and your choices regarding that information.

Information We Collect

When you submit a request through our quote request form, we may collect your name, email address, phone number, company or property name, service location, the service you are requesting, your preferred contact method, and any additional details you choose to share with us.

How We Use Your Information

We use the information you provide to respond to your request, prepare a quote, and communicate with you about our services. We do not sell or rent your personal information to third parties.

How We Share Information

We do not share your personal information with third parties, except as needed to provide the services you request, to comply with a legal obligation, or with your consent.

Data Security

We take reasonable measures to protect the information you share with us. However, no method of transmission over the internet is completely secure, and we cannot guarantee absolute security.

Your Choices

You may contact us at jtprotectionllc@gmail.com at any time to ask what information we have about you, to request that we correct it, or to request that we delete it.

Children's Privacy

Our website and services are not directed to individuals under 18, and we do not knowingly collect information from children.

Changes to This Policy

We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. The date at the top of this page reflects the most recent update.

Contact Us

If you have questions about this Privacy Policy, contact us at jtprotectionllc@gmail.com or (321) 848-6744.
